listing.name: International Superstar Soccer 2000 — ISS2000 (djultra64)
listing.summary: This early project describes PAL career and training support, with alignment and rendering issues. Upstream’s Windows observation reaches only the intro, and its close test was cancelled. Gameplay and normal exit remain unconfirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe English/German revision 0 ROM, SHA-256 6ce6739b8ead149857c9442178a1ecd9b7f6d15b93a582c7208ca85d493817bf.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The v0.7.1 README describes portable packages for selecting your own ROM. This guide has not confirmed the exact package files or source revision; check the project’s instructions for the package you choose.

warnings: This early project describes PAL career and training support, with alignment and rendering issues. Upstream’s Windows observation reaches only the intro, and its close test was cancelled. Gameplay and normal exit remain unconfirmed.
